verdict.rationale: Community hands-on reports show DeepSeek models consumed through OpenRouter, including comparisons of DeepSeek 3.1, 3.2 and v4 there, and an OpenRouter provider listing. That confirms availability through an OpenRouter-class router beyond the vendor endpoint. The first-party docs only describe OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible access to DeepSeek's own API, and nothing in the pack shows the models on any major cloud. Missing for 10: evidence of availability on Bedrock, Vertex or Azure, first-party documentation of third-party gateway or cloud distribution, and confirmation that router-hosted models match the vendor's models.
